---
title: "PET data analysis workshop"
subtitle: "Human Functional Brain Imaging, PET day, 14 October 2026"
---

In this workshop, you take PET data from the raw files to estimated outcomes:

1. [Convert raw PET data to BIDS](01-ezbids.qmd) with ezBIDS.
2. [Look at the outputs of PETPrep](02-petprep.qmd), the PET preprocessing pipeline.
3. [Model the arterial blood data](03-bloodstream.qmd) with bloodstream.
4. [Fit kinetic models](04-petfit.qmd) to regional time-activity curves with PETFit.
5. [Look at surface-based kinetic modelling](05-petsurfer.qmd) with PETSurfer.
6. [Estimate drug occupancy](06-lassen.qmd) with a Lassen plot.

You work in your own Neurodesk session on the course server. Everything you create goes in your home folder. The course data are read-only, so you can't break anything for anyone else.

Start with [Before you start](setup.qmd).

## The dataset

Most of the workshop uses \[^11^C\]MC1, a radioligand for cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), from OpenNeuro dataset [ds004869](https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds004869). It has two groups of healthy participants:

| Group | Participants | Sessions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Blocking | sub-01 to sub-10 | `baseline`, and `blocked` after 600 mg celecoxib, a COX-2 inhibitor |
| Test-retest | sub-11 to sub-27 | `test` and `retest` |

Every scan has arterial blood data: plasma and whole-blood radioactivity, and the parent fraction measured with HPLC.

In bloodstream, you analyse six participants: sub-02, sub-05, and sub-08 from the blocking group, and sub-11, sub-13, and sub-14 from the test-retest group. In PETFit, you analyse three participants: sub-02 and sub-10 from the blocking group, and sub-15 from the test-retest group.

For the BIDS conversion in part 1, you use a separate set of raw DICOM files: \[^11^C\]PE2I, \[^18^F\]FE-PE2I, and \[^15^O\]water PET, and a T1-weighted MRI, from two participants.
